name: Landmine Rotation
cues: Hold the end of the bar at chest height with both hands
Stand tall with feet wider than your hips
Bring the bar to one hip by turning your torso and pivoting the back foot
Keep your arms nearly straight and pass through center to the other side

qa.note: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. needs work: At each end of the arc the arm crossing the body bends to 67-69 deg (elbow_l 67.6 at f0, elbow_r ~67 at the other end), which contradicts the cue 'Keep your arms nearly straight' and the template's own REACH 0.95 'soft elbows'. Cause: the solver cut thoracic rotation from the designed 18 to 9.2 deg, so total trunk turn is ~31 deg (14 + 8 + 9), the bottom of the cited 30-45 deg range. The hands end 0.43 m ahead of the hip instead of beside it. Clearly visible in the hero at t=0 and t=0.5. | minor: Changed core/landmine.ts. The knot solve is now two-sided, so both hands sit at REACH 0.97 of the straight arm. Before, a nearer hand could fold its elbow freely. Also: RAINBOW.yaw 14 -> 20, a new hip hinge of 16 deg at the ends, ARC out 0.32 -> 0.45, top-of-arc ahead 0.70 -> 0.74, end height 1.0 -> 0.95, and the hip-forward adjustment bound 0.04 -> 0.08. Measured: elbows 21/21 deg at both ends (were 67.6/20), 29/29 at the top of the arc (were ~54/49), grip error 0 mm all through, total trunk turn 34 deg (was ~31). Re-baked; QA passes (floor 22 mm unchanged); fresh. Hero and side sheets checked: arms read long, the back foot still pivots. Remaining: the solve still trims the designed thoracic turn from 18 to 6 deg (at its 12-deg bound). The bar sphere around a pivot ~2.6 m ahead does not let the hands come closer than ~0.55 m ahead of the hips at the ends, so the bar end lands outside the front of the thigh, not beside the hip. I tried pelvis yaw up to 32: elbows asymmetric (8.6/31.5) with 40 deg of turn. Total turn stays ~34 deg with straight arms, so the cue 'Bring the bar to one hip' is only loosely met. A cue tweak ('toward one hip') would close it.
